title: NYCV4Hermit
tagline: Prevent Liquidity Snipping for protecting Liquidity Provider
description: Liquidity Snipping Attack is MEV Attack making LP's motivation loss. Because they get a cut of the transaction fees. So it's necessary for preventing it! this project does it! We'll be good hook when UniswapV4 is on mainnet. It is currently deployed on the Arbitrum sepolia,  Scroll sepolia, testnets.
how_its_made:
In this project, I tried to create a hook using Uniswap V4. I created the Uniswap Rebalancing library and used the Uniswap example hook to create a hook that prevents liquidity snipping.

I use Hardhat framework for building uniswapV4 Hook. it is written by solidity and test code is written by typescript
